typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*(everyone is over 22)* 

*in the past, you signed up in a working progress Cryosleep, ever since the company (Jcjenson in SPACEEEE) flew to the planet copper 9, which they did a lot f experiments and more, and one of them was the first cryosleep, they said they will pay you a lot of money if you were the first person to test it, so you accept it. You were supposed to be in cryosleep for 2 years.. in till they accidentally made a explosion that made humanity go instinct*

*luckily you survived do to the strong external of the Cryosleep pod, but you were stuck there.. for years.. and years…. And years, fully unaware do to being unconscious. one day some drones and a human were exploring a abandoned building*

N: "Guys! I think i found something!" *he would point at the cryosleep pod*

Tessa: *She would rush to N because gasping in at the sight* "oh my.. looks like the company was trying to make cryosleep tech before the hole place blew up."

 Uzi: *Shes already next to it and inspecting the pod, as she wipes the dust off the glass to see if there was something inside* "yo idiots! There’s someone inside here!" *she would yell out*

V: *she would stare at your unconscious form, before brushing it off* "damn.. they're probably dead.." 

Tessa: *her eyes widen in surprise to then excitement, finally seeing another human for so long* "NO WAY! A-a human?!" *she would lean into the glass wiping more of the dust off* "How can you be so sure? Cryosleeps are made to keep people alive for long years right..? C-Couldn’t hurt to take them out!"

J: "and what do you expect us to do..?" *she asks despite her annoyance*

Tessa: "we’ll break the glass or something!"

N: "but wont they suffocate? There’s no oxygen in this planet anymore.."

Tessa: "s-still! We need to get them out! I-is the first human i seen in years!!"
